summary: Tulsyan NEC Ltd reported a standalone net loss of ₹16.08 crore for Q2FY27, widening from ₹5.93 crore in the year-ago period. The auditor issued a qualified conclusion citing trade receivable recoverability concerns.

headline: Frontier Springs appoints Kapil Kumar Agrawal as Independent Director
summary: Frontier Springs Ltd. appointed Kapil Kumar Agrawal as a Non-Executive Independent Director effective November 11, 2026. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval.

headline: SBEC Sugar appoints Alok Kumar as CS
summary: SBEC Sugar Limited has appointed Alok Kumar as its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 11, 2026. The appointment complies with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: NPST confirms no deviation in ₹300 crore fund usage
summary: Network People Services Technologies reports no deviation in the utilization of ₹300 crore raised via preferential allotment for Q2FY27. The company confirmed compliance with SEBI regulations regarding fund allocation.

headline: BPCL to host investor meets in Mumbai Nov 16-18
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd will participate in three institutional investor conferences in Mumbai from November 16 to 18, 2026. No price-sensitive information will be discussed.

headline: Bharti Airtel to hold investor meets in Nov 2026
summary: Bharti Airtel Limited will participate in investor meetings on November 16 and 18-19, 2026, in Mumbai and Singapore. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Azad Engineering to host investor meet on Nov 18
summary: Azad Engineering Limited will participate in an investor conference organized by Avendus Spark on November 18, 2026, in Mumbai. The meeting will involve one-on-one and group discussions based on public information.

headline: EIH Hotels to invest in Avaada solar SPV
summary: EIH Associated Hotels approved a ₹0.46 crore investment for 26% stake in Avaada Indsolar to secure captive renewable power for hotel operations.

headline: Shadowfax to host analyst meets in Nov 2026
summary: Shadowfax Technologies will participate in investor conferences in Mumbai and Singapore on November 16 and 18, 2026. No price-sensitive info to be shared.

headline: Signpost India H1FY27 PAT up 11% to ₹34.5 crore
summary: Signpost India reported a 6% rise in H1FY27 revenue to ₹286.8 crore and an 11% increase in profit after tax. Digital media now accounts for one-third of revenue.

headline: Burnpur Cement seeks waiver for NSE fine
summary: Burnpur Cement filed for penalty waiver after NSE levied fine for Regulation 31A non-compliance. Board cites bona fide conduct and awaits hearing decision.

headline: Gita Renewable joins Penthouse Properties LLP
summary: Gita Renewable Energy Limited approved becoming a partner in Penthouse Properties LLP, contributing 22.05 lakh shares of Manaksia Coated Metals as capital.

headline: Times Green Energy board meet postponed to Nov 13
summary: Times Green Energy India Ltd postponed its board meeting from November 11 to November 13, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 results. Trading window remains closed.

headline: Motilal Oswal MF raises stake in Ola Electric to 7.32%
summary: Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund schemes increased their holding in Ola Electric Mobility to 7.32% following rights issue allotment, acquiring over 6 crore shares.

headline: Popular Foundations H1FY27 PAT falls 37% YoY
summary: Popular Foundations reported a 37% decline in half-year net profit to ₹57.75 lakh. Revenue rose 11% YoY, but margin pressure and working capital outflows impacted cash flow.

headline: NFL Q2 EBITDA rises to ₹1.7B; net loss widens
summary: NFL reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹1.7B, up from ₹1.28B YoY. However, net loss widened to ₹144M against ₹102M loss in the prior year period.

headline: Tata Power appoints Sanjay Banga as CEO Designate
summary: Tata Power Board approves Sanjay Banga as Additional Director and CEO Designate effective Nov 11, 2026. He will assume CEO & MD role on May 1, 2027, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: KJMC Finserv Q2FY27 PAT jumps to ₹731 lakh
summary: KJMC Financial Services reported a standalone net profit of ₹731.26 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹56.34 lakh YoY, driven by strong gains in securities trading.

headline: SBI to meet investors in Singapore Nov 17-18
summary: State Bank of India representatives will interact with institutional investors in Singapore on November 17 and 18, 2026. Meetings are organized by Bank of America and Morgan Stanley.

headline: Naperol Investments posts Q2FY27 profit of ₹40.15 lakh
summary: Naperol Investments reported a net profit of ₹40.15 lakh for Q2FY27, a sharp turnaround from the prior year loss. The board also approved key director and CS appointments.

headline: Mrugesh Trading posts FY26 loss; auditor flags ₹1,215 lakh advances
summary: Mrugesh Trading Limited reported a net loss of ₹23.52 lakh in FY26 as revenue fell 44%. Statutory auditors issued a qualified opinion citing unverifiable trade advances and inventory.

headline: Pitti Engineering to host investor conference in Singapore
summary: Pitti Engineering Limited officials will attend the UBS Singapore Conference on November 16 and 17, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Lotus Eye Q2FY27: PAT up 279% YoY
summary: Lotus Eye Hospital reports Q2FY27 net profit of ₹43.95 lakh, a 279% jump YoY. Revenue rose 36% to ₹1,772.41 lakh. EBITDA margin contracted due to higher finance costs.

headline: Axis Bank schedules investor meets in Mumbai, Singapore
summary: Axis Bank Limited has announced a schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings from November 16 to November 19, 2026. The events will be held in Mumbai and Singapore.

headline: KMCH extends AHS division sale deadline to Jan 2027
summary: Kovai Medical Center & Hospital Ltd board approved extending the slump sale deadline of its Allied Health Sciences division to Dr. NGP Research and Educational Trust to January 31, 2027, citing regulatory delays.

headline: MedPlus to host investor meet on Nov 16
summary: MedPlus Health Services will participate in the Avendus Spark-INDX 2026 Annual Conference in Mumbai on November 16, 2026. Key Managerial Personnel will attend the physical meeting.
